# Curated audio test fixtures

This directory is reserved for small, legally distributable test audio. No audio is included yet.

Before adding a fixture, record its filename, test purpose, creator/source, license or permission to redistribute, and any required attribution here. Prefer short, synthetic recordings generated for the test. Do not add personal music libraries or copyrighted audio without redistribution rights.

Only supported media files directly in this directory are exempted from the repository's media ignore rules. Nested directories and ordinary music libraries remain ignored. Fixture size limits and the format test matrix should be agreed during the audio PoC.
